centring: a shift is slope x (x - the centre), the centre being the outcome's mean covariate over its base events (pass 1), so the league mean stays on the base

covariates.alt: a game at Denver's home venue
covariates.alt_edge: +1 Denver offense at home, -1 visiting offense at Denver
covariates.body_edge: visiting club in Pacific time and a 13:00 ET start, +1 home offense / -1 visiting offense
covariates.indoor: roof dome or closed (an open retractable counts as outdoor)
covariates.missing: an outdoor game without temp or wind leaves every weather model
covariates.precip: the weather string mentions rain, snow, shower, drizzle, sleet, flurries or storm (report only)
covariates.tz_edge: |home-club UTC offset - visiting-club UTC offset| hours, +1 home offense / -1 visiting offense; 0 at neutral sites

information_boundary: NFL regular seasons 2010-2013 and 2014 Weeks 1-4 (games through September 29, 2014), cut at fetch; pooled slopes only (no club, kicker or punter fixed effect stored); no club, game, player or date field.
keep_rule: preregistered sign, full-sample sign, positive leave-one-stadium-out skill, pass-2 reproduction; kept terms refit jointly, a term whose joint sign flips dropped (lower single skill first); altitude terms at slope 0 (decision 1B.2)

pass_yds.channel: report only (no channel in the drive replay)

rush_yds.channel: report only (no channel in the drive replay)

plan_and_defensive_calls: The offense plan test is reported only and cannot be adopted in 2014.6; defensive records label each snap with Stone's sheet (decision 1B.5): nothing here.
